SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2024-09-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), _cm_orders__amount_sum_window_3m AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(_src._w_value) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue_3m"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date"
    FROM orders AS orders
    WHERE
      (
        orders.order_date >= CAST('2024-09-01' AS DATE)
        AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      )
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
  ) AS _base
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      orders.order_date AS _w_time,
      orders.amount AS _w_value
    FROM orders AS orders
  ) AS _src
    ON _src._w_time >= CAST(CAST(_base."orders.order_date" + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE)
    AND _src._w_time < CAST(_base."orders.order_date" + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    _base."orders.order_date"
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.order_date",
  _cm_orders__amount_sum_window_3m."orders.revenue_3m"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_window_3m
  ON _base."orders.order_date" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_sum_window_3m."orders.order_date"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.order_date" ASC
LIMIT 21
